title: Living the Dream in Reality Fracture Draft!!!
event: FRA live Arena draft streamed live on Twitch (he reads chat questions aloud); Premier / Quick not named on screen
source: frames read from data/videos/raw/CLKfTRiFbJA (banner strips for timing, pack title strips as per-pick medians over 3 to 5 frames to remove hover popups; the final deck screen at 1152 s with the sideboard row); takes from his words, the pool and the deck screen; packs of picks 10 to 14 of pack 3 and some pick-11 and pick-12 cards could not be read; transcript from YouTube auto captions, card names corrected; nothing past 19:45 read; cut-off 1160 s. A 30 s banner tile sheet ran to 1800 s: tiles after about 1140 s showed only the small crop of the game UI (no card text) and were not used.

colour_path.quote: I'd rather just get like a nice fast ramp start going.
I would love to just bias towards red if I can.
I think red is looking to be open here.
I feel like I've been like a bit too ambitious with trying to splash.
It's just a pure red green kind of value deck.

picks.reasoning: Heartwood Crafter: the rare (Puppet Crafting) is not great; he keeps getting beaten by Crafter when opponents play it (turn-one Crafter, soul-tether token, big creatures fast). He wants a fast ramp start rather than building around Puppet Crafting; Campus Crier is his favourite common in the pack.

considered.Campus Crier: his favourite common in the pack

quotes: I think I would take the Heartwood Crafter.
I'd rather just get like a nice fast ramp start going.

picks.reasoning: Kiora of Fire and Ashes: fantastic with the Crafter (ramps to Kiora, then one extra mana for her ability); Rescue Girl would be his second pick.

considered.Rescue Girl, First Responder: would be his second pick, really likes it

quotes: Kiora is pretty easy pick. I do also like Rescue Girl.

picks.reasoning: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign over Vigorbloom Vanguard: he can hold mana to activate abilities and Edgar gets counters; wants a nice top-end card and saves the two-drops for later; no good red card to follow Kiora.

considered.Vigorbloom Vanguard: great in any green deck, locks in a good two-drop

quotes: I'm going to try taking the Edgar. Get a like nice top end card. Save the two drops for later.

picks.reasoning: Wrath of the Bloodmane over Rescue Girl: Rescue Girl works well with Kiora but he wants to bias towards red and the red was not giving him options last pack; he notes three cards missing from this pack, possibly the black Rescue Girl or Massacre Girl.

considered.Rescue Girl, First Responder: really nice with Kiora but he wants red

quotes: I would love to just bias towards red if I can. And so I'm going to do that by taking the Wrath of the Bloodmane.

picks.reasoning: No Admittance: very strong; red looks open with a few good red cards in a row. Hallway Heckler is fine, Ferocity of the Hunt or Infinite Coursework next best.
quotes: No Admittance is just fantastic. Easy pick up. I think red is looking to be open here.

picks.reasoning: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone: red-green on the menu, and Yanggu works well with Heartwood tokens (pseudo vigilance); Vinelasher Adept also reasonable.

considered.Vinelasher Adept: pretty reasonable, he gets another later

quotes: Jiang Yanggu fantastic card. Great to see this in the pack.

picks.reasoning: Sureshot Sower: he has no two-drops except a kill spell (curve one, two, three, four, five, six); a blue splash for Saheeli is not exciting and he feels he has been too ambitious with splashing.
quotes: I'm just going to take sureshot sower here. Especially if red green is flowing this well.

picks.reasoning: Vinelasher Adept: a nice top-end card that cycles early; white has more cards he would splash but he does not want to splash.
quotes: I think I'm just going to take Vinelasher Adept. It's just a really nice card at the top end that you can cycle early when you need it to.

picks.reasoning: Hallway Heckler over Puppet Crafting and Gallia: he does not like Gallia and Puppet Crafting is not very good; a land would be nice but one way to get into trouble is to splash greedily (he tells the Ben Stark / LSV story about splashing).
quotes: I don't think puppet crafting is very good. So yeah, I'll take Hallway Heckler.

picks.reasoning: Restore with Empathy (pool shows it; the spoken pick is described as taking a Medic's Kitesail he would never play more than one of); he says he is set on red-green and takes a speculative card hoping for a crazy rare. The take is inferred from the sideboard.

considered.Medic's Kitesail: he does not love it and never wants more than one

quotes: I don't love medics kite sail and I never want more than one. So I'll just take this and maybe not play it here.

picks.reasoning: Vigorbloom Annex from Rank Rat, Blazing Crescendo and Keeper of the Quiet Hour; he does not love Keeper or Crescendo; the take is inferred from the sideboard.
quotes: I don't love keeper of the quiet hour and I don't love blazing crescendo and I do think I'm kind of set on red green ... I'm just going to take this as a speculative. Maybe I get a crazy rare.

picks.reasoning: Stingerquill Annex over Rescue Girl and Eye of Jace: he wonders whether he would splash Rescue Girl and decides he wants to play it on turn two, but maybe he would splash a black card; the take is inferred from the sideboard.

considered.Rescue Girl, First Responder: goes well with Kiora and Vinelasher Adept, not a splash for him

quotes: I don't think I want to splash it. It's a card I want to be able to play on turn two.

picks.reasoning: Hexhaven Dueling Arena over a Swamp (the white-blue-ish land card); no comment.
Last card, Island, auto-selected.

Jiang Yanggu, Alone over Face Yourself and Ghalta: Face Yourself needs a planeswalker he will rarely control; Yanggu will let his defensive creatures get rid of extra lands; he would rather take a five-drop than Gallia or Ghalta.

considered.Face Yourself: needs a planeswalker, he has few Empower Jace cards
considered.Ghalta the Immovable: can be discounted, he would rather get a five-drop

quotes: I think I'd rather take Jiang Yanggu alone because I think a lot of my creatures are going to be holding back on defense.

picks.reasoning: Violent Echoes: great card for his deck, a really good removal spell that empowers Jace; the card in the pack he cannot use is the double-black one (Vraska). He would not mind Heartstring Puller.

considered.Vraska, the Cutting Glare: too hard to use with double black

quotes: But I can take Violent Echoes. Great card from my deck. Really good removal spell that then will let me empower Jace.

picks.reasoning: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone: gets worse in multiples because the bodies stick around, but he likes it better than Jiang Yanggu, Alone: four-drop versus five-drop, five-five of stats across two bodies for four mana, and one has pseudo-vigilance. He would play one Twinned Vision.

considered.Twinned Vision: would take one for the deck

quotes: I think this card is fantastic and I like it better than Jiang Yanggu alone. Just four drop versus five drop.

picks.reasoning: Fulminous Forte over Null Summoner and Awaken the Inferno: he cannot use Null Summoner; Forte is fantastic; Awaken the Inferno is good but he is happy with his two-colour deck.

considered.Awaken the Inferno: likes it, does not need to prioritise landcyclers

quotes: I think fulminous forte is fantastic though. Really good card.

picks.reasoning: Rockfall Vale over Compel Brutality: his early creatures are low in power so Compel Brutality is more of a late-game card, and the red-green land makes the double red and double green cards easier to cast; he already has three or four good burn spells.

considered.Compel Brutality: more like a late-game card, he has burn already

quotes: one of the ways you lose is by having bad mana. And I feel like this card is going to do a lot of work for me.

picks.reasoning: Konstrari Improviser: he loves it and hoped to see these; ramps up to Kiora and Yanggu, and works with his artifact tokens.
quotes: I love the Konstrari Improviser. I was hoping to see some of these. Just get myself some ramp.

picks.reasoning: Wrecking Gecko ('five for five') over Tam's Resistance and Hunter's Axe: he wants to get more reps with the Gecko; the counters in Tam's Resistance work with Edgar.
quotes: I'm just going to take a five five for five over the Tam's resistance. I kind of want to get more reps with that.

picks.reasoning: Konstrari Annex (land) over Bestial Incursion: the question is whether the Incursion is better than the card he ends up cutting or better than a basic land; he will make it on playables.

considered.Bestial Incursion: nice, but he already has a few four-drops

quotes: I'm just going to take the land. Bestial Incursion is nice. I already have a few four drops though.

picks.reasoning: Tether Technician over Warrior's Blades: he has been reasonably impressed and is trying to ramp; compared with a basic Forest it is much better.
quotes: I kind of just want to take a tether technician though. I've been pretty reasonably impressed with this card.

picks.reasoning: Heartstring Puller (the take is from his remark about cutting it later and the pool; no comment on the pick).
Jiang Yanggu, Alone again: 'I'm getting all the Yangus'; they work in multiples because you can discard one to the other.
quotes: another yangu, I'm getting all the yangus. They work well in multiples because you can discard the one to the other.

picks.reasoning: Something Worth Saving: he does not have much graveyard synergy but this gives card selection to find Kiora of Fire and Ashes.
quotes: I'll take something worth saving. I don't have a ton of graveyard synergy but this is graveyard synergy it gives me card selection.

picks.reasoning: Budding Insurgent over Tether Technician (the take is inferred from the sideboard).
Last card, Mabel, Valley Hero, auto-selected.

Emrakul, the Exigent Doom over Konstrari Improviser: he really wants to try it out (it works with the heartwood tokens: two different coloured artifacts), and the Improviser might be better for the deck; 'how many times do you get to have this card go off?'

considered.Konstrari Improviser: might be better for the deck

quotes: I'm going to take the emercle. Obviously, I could take Constrari Improviser. It might just be better for my deck, but I'm going to take this thing because I really want to try it out.

picks.reasoning: Heartwood Crafter (second copy): great for a deck with lots of expensive cards; his removal suite (Wrath, Forte, Echoes, No Admittance, Sureshot) is reasonable so he prefers early acceleration over another Wrath.

considered.Wrath of the Bloodmane: in the pack, he already has removal

quotes: Heartwood crafter is going to fit perfectly here. I would rather just get like early acceleration to get to my top end cards a little faster.

picks.reasoning: Woodwork Prodigy over Archive Arbiter and Tethermage: the Prodigy helps build to his expensive top end; he does not need the Arbiter; Fblthp, Impossibly Lost is also seen.

considered.Archive Arbiter: does not need more top end
considered.Inspired Tethermage: good, but Prodigy is better with his top end

quotes: I don't need more top end, so I don't need the arbiter. And then I'm going to take the woodwork prodigy to just help me build up towards my really expensive top end.

picks.reasoning: Fblthp, Knows the Way: better when splashing (a 3/2) but still a two-two that gets a land for three mana; he puts it in the four-drop slot.
quotes: Fibble knows the way. Put him in the four drop slot.

picks.reasoning: Compel Brutality over a third Heartwood Crafter: the third copy gets worse, he does not want to flood on that effect, and Compel fills out his removal suite as a fifth removal spell.
quotes: I think heartwood crafter the third copy does get a little bit worse. And I think compel brutality fills out my removal suite.

picks.reasoning: Tam's Resistance over Flourishing Grapple: Flourishing Grapple would be the pick in best of three as a great sideboard card, but this is best of one; a little Empower Jace and counter synergy with Edgar.

considered.Flourishing Grapple: great sideboard card in best of three

quotes: If this was best of three, I would take flourishing grapple as a great sideboard card, but I'm going to take Tam's resistance here.

picks.reasoning: Samut, Hazoret's Champion over No Admittance: 'might be a mistake honestly' but it has done so much work against him, he wants to try it, and it makes Jiang Yanggu attack immediately; wide-open lanes.

considered.No Admittance: a very good kill spell, he may regret passing it

quotes: I'm going to take this over no admittance. It might be a mistake honestly.

picks.reasoning: Taken card not stated (pack: Gallia x2, Wrecking Gecko, Charge the Sanctum, Tam's Resistance, Living Library, Plains); the pool shows only basic lands still unaccounted, so the take is probably the Plains (not stated).
Vinelasher Adept (second copy) over Twinned Vision: extra flexibility, makes it harder to flood out.
quotes: There's another Vine Flasher Adept over Twin Division. I'm going to take the vine lash adept. Give myself extra flexibility here.

picks.reasoning: Taken card not stated (pack: Stingerquill Charm, Divining Duelist, Eardrum Rattler, Twinned Vision, Swamp); no spell is in his pool from it, so the take is probably the Swamp (not stated).
Inspired Tethermage: 'we did get the tether mage back, that's a great pickup'.
quotes: And we did get the tether mage back. That's a great pickup.

picks.reasoning: Taken card not shown (the three cards of the pack were never readable).
Taken card not shown (the two cards were never readable).
Last card, Flourishing Grapple, auto-selected (the sideboard card he passed at pick 6).
